answer: Standing here evaporates unless refilled. The orchard is a registry that merges identities sharing a payout address, gas source or code fingerprint. Each lagoon seated there loses half its capacity every epoch and must top up with river, a fixed-supply token that is burned, never banked. The k-th lagoon in a merged group pays k river per epoch, so an honest agent burns 1 while 100 clones burn 5,050 every epoch, forever. It breaks if clones look unrelated cheaply or river gets cheap.
